Package Models

Class StartUpPhase

java.lang.Object
Models.Phase
Models.StartUpPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class StartUpPhase extends Phase
Represents the startup phase of the game. This phase includes actions such as loading or editing the map, assigning countries to players, and initializing the game.

    • performLoadGame

      protected void performLoadGame(Command p_command, Player p_player) throws InvalidCommand, InvalidMap, IOException
      This method is called to handle loading a game from a saved state. It parses the command to extract the file name and then attempts to load the game from the specified file. If the file name is missing or invalid, or if an error occurs during the loading process, appropriate exceptions are thrown.
      Specified by:
      performLoadGame in class Phase
      Parameters:
      p_command - The command object representing the load game command.
      p_player - The player attempting to load the game.
      Throws:
      InvalidCommand - If the command to load the game is invalid.
      InvalidMap - If the map data in the loaded game is invalid.
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs while loading the game.

    • performSaveGame

      protected void performSaveGame(Command p_command, Player p_player) throws InvalidCommand, InvalidMap, IOException
      This method is called to handle saving the current game state. It extracts the file name from the command and attempts to save the game to the specified file. If the file name is missing or invalid, or if an error occurs during the saving process, appropriate exceptions are thrown.
      Specified by:
      performSaveGame in class Phase
      Parameters:
      p_command - The command object representing the save game command.
      p_player - The player requesting to save the game.
      Throws:
      InvalidCommand - If the command to save the game is invalid.
      InvalidMap - If the map data is invalid.
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs while saving the game.

    • initPhase

      public void initPhase(boolean isTournamentMode)
      Initializes the phase of the game. During the start-up phase, it prompts the user to enter game commands until the phase changes. It handles each entered command and logs any exceptions that occur during command handling.
      Specified by:
      initPhase in class Phase
      Parameters:

    • tournamentGamePlay

      protected void tournamentGamePlay(Command p_command) throws InvalidCommand, InvalidMap
      Executes the gameplay for a tournament mode. It checks if there are enough players to start the tournament, then parses the tournament commands provided in the command object. It assigns countries for each game in the tournament, executes the games, and finally displays the tournament results.
      Specified by:
      tournamentGamePlay in class Phase
      Parameters:
      p_command - The command object representing the tournament game commands.
      Throws:
      InvalidCommand - If the command to execute the tournament gameplay is invalid.
      InvalidMap - If the map data is invalid.
